humanReadableSummary: Returns Policy v2.0 (Historical 2024): 7-day standard return window + 3-day Gold extension, 10% restocking fee. Return required prior to refund.
Returns Policy v3.0 (Active 2025-Present): 14-day standard return window + 7-day Gold extension (total 21 days for Gold members), 5% restocking fee.

Refund Policy v1.0 (Active): Max Refund = min(Requested, Order Value - Prior Refunds - Restocking Fee). Automated execution capped at ₹10,000 threshold. Amounts above ₹10,000 mandate supervisor escalation.

Delivery Policy v1.0 (Active): Where carrier dispatch records confirm customer OTP verification, non-delivery claims constitute a high-severity contradiction. Auto-refund and in-transit address re-routing are strictly prohibited; requires human logistics escalation.

Warranty Policy v1.0 (Active): Defective hardware or functional degradation within manufacturer warranty period must be routed to Authorized Service Specialist for RMA / OEM inspection. Ordinary purchase returns/refunds are blocked.
